run_download_s2ef_data: run the script to download and preprocess s2ef training data for a specified split like 200k or all
run_download_is2re_data: run the script to download and extract is2re train val test LMDB datasets
run_get_data_function: run the get_data function to download extract and organize s2ef or is2re task data
run_verify_count_function: run the verify_count function to validate that s2ef split data counts match expected values
run_cleanup_function: run the cleanup function to remove intermediate tar files and uncompressed directories after data processing
